title: Notely
tagline: Android notes app (Java) — the product face of a larger organizer-app series.
overview: Notely is a Java Android notes app. Related organizers (FlowNote, TaskMate, and others) are grouped as an open-source lab so this page stays a real product entry instead of ten thin clones.
problem: I needed a notes client that was more than a tutorial list, while a swarm of near-identical task apps did not each deserve a case study.
solution: Ship Notely as the notes product; park the rest under the Android organizer lab.
architecture: Java Android application. Sibling repos share the same era and forge.
challenges: Choosing one notes app to represent a family of experiments
lessonsLearned: Portfolio density is a design problem, not a git problem
futureImprovements: Deep link the organizer-lab case study from this page
results: A single notes product plus a grouped lab instead of a wall of twins
